name: 索菲亚·科瓦列夫斯卡娅

points.title: 早年教育
points.description: 索菲亚·科瓦列夫斯卡娅在圣彼得堡接受了早期的教育，她的父亲是一位数学家，对她的数学天赋给予了极大的支持。她在这里开始了对数学的深入研究，并自学了微积分和高等数学。
points.descriptionEn: Sofia Kovalevskaya received her early education in St. Petersburg, with her father, a mathematician, supporting her mathematical talents. Here, she began to delve deeply into mathematics and self-studied calculus and higher mathematics.

points.title: 学术研究
points.description: 科瓦列夫斯卡娅在哥廷根大学继续她的数学研究，成为该校第一位女性数学博士。她在那里发表了关于数学物理的论文，对波动方程和流体动力学做出了重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: Kovalevskaya continued her mathematical research at the University of Göttingen, becoming the first woman to receive a Ph.D. in mathematics from the university. There, she published papers on mathematical physics, making significant contributions to wave equations and fluid dynamics.

points.title: 学术交流
points.description: 科瓦列夫斯卡娅在巴黎与数学家们交流，包括卡尔·魏尔斯特拉斯和恩斯特·海因里希·韦伯。她的研究引起了广泛关注，并获得了法国科学院的奖金。
points.descriptionEn: Kovalevskaya engaged in academic exchanges in Paris with mathematicians such as Karl Weierstrass and Ernst Heinrich Weber. Her research garnered wide attention and she was awarded a prize by the French Academy of Sciences.

points.title: 学术成就
points.description: 在罗马，科瓦列夫斯卡娅完成了她的博士论文，并发表了关于数学物理的论文，这些工作使她在数学界获得了极高的声誉。她还与著名物理学家恩斯特·马赫有过深入的学术交流。
points.descriptionEn: In Rome, Kovalevskaya completed her doctoral dissertation and published papers on mathematical physics, which earned her high acclaim in the mathematical community. She also had in-depth academic exchanges with the famous physicist Ernst Mach.

points.title: 教授生涯
points.description: 科瓦列夫斯卡娅在柏林大学担任数学教授，成为该校第一位女性教授。她的教学和研究成果对后来的女性数学家产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Kovalevskaya served as a mathematics professor at the University of Berlin, becoming the first woman professor there. Her teaching and research had a profound impact on later female mathematicians.

appraisal.zh: 索菲亚·科瓦列夫斯卡娅被视为数学史上杰出的女性，也是女性数学的先驱之一，其贡献推动了数学特别是数学物理的发展，坚韧不拔与求知渴望构成她的精神遗产，她的经历为后来的女性数学家树立了榜样。也有研究者指出，她的一生和事业深受性别歧视影响，成就虽卓越，学术地位却未总获应有认可。
appraisal.en: Sofia Kovalevskaya is regarded as an outstanding woman in the history of mathematics and one of the pioneers of women in the field, her contributions advancing mathematics, especially mathematical physics, while her tenacity and thirst for knowledge form her legacy and her example served later women mathematicians as a model. Yet some researchers point out that her life and career were shaped by gender discrimination, and that despite outstanding achievements her standing in the academic world was not always duly recognized.

supporter.zh: 索菲亚·科瓦列夫斯卡娅被视为数学史上的一位杰出女性，她的贡献在于推动了数学的发展，特别是数学物理领域。她的精神遗产在于她的坚韧不拔和对知识的渴望。
supporter.en: Sofia Kovalevskaya is regarded as an outstanding woman in the history of mathematics, her contributions lie in promoting the development of mathematics, especially in the field of mathematical physics. Her legacy is her tenacity and thirst for knowledge.

critic.zh: 批评者可能会指出，科瓦列夫斯卡娅的生活和事业受到了性别歧视的影响。她的成就虽然卓越，但她在学术界的地位并不总是得到应有的认可。
critic.en: Critics might point out that Kovalevskaya's life and career were affected by gender discrimination. Although her achievements were outstanding, her status in the academic community was not always recognized as it should have been.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，科瓦列夫斯卡娅被视为女性数学的先驱之一，她的工作和生活经历为后来的女性数学家树立了榜样。在大众文化中，她通常被描绘为一位勇敢、聪明和独立的女性。
objective.en: In the academic community, Kovalevskaya is seen as one of the pioneers of women in mathematics, her work and life experiences serving as a role model for later female mathematicians. In popular culture, she is often portrayed as a brave, intelligent, and independent woman.

self.zh: 数学是我的生命，我愿意为它献出我的一切。
self.en: Mathematics is my life, and I am willing to sacrifice everything for it.
